description: Legacy key flow: list the original game through media and platform links. Agent html/files require preview_review. Prefer publish_game for one-operation submission. List the original game with media and platform links by default. Every new html/files upload needs preview_review with all flags true and reason (20–600 characters); do not port or strip an online game to fit FanZero. Each call creates a new game; use update_game for an existing one. check_build is optional; publication never requires adapting a game. Reuse authorized listing and pact terms. Prefer publish_game for one operation. Pacts remain exclusive across every store for 28 days from the earliest creator-proposed action.

agent.description: Which agent is calling, e.g. "claude-code" or "codex"

api_key.description: Studio API key. Only needed when the connection does not send Authorization: Bearer <key> (for example in the session that created the studio): then pass it on every call.

description.description: What the game is, its audience and what creators can show (60-4000 chars)

dev_note.description: A personal note from the dev to streamers

files.description: Optional justified playable preview instead of html; needs index.html and preview_review. Do not adapt an online game just to host a preview

path.description: Relative path, e.g. index.html or assets/sprite.png

html.description: Original game links are the default. Add optional self-contained html only with preview_review declaring representative, sandbox-tested and preferable to direct access; max 8 MB

media.description: Screenshots, gameplay and trailers. At least one when no optional playable version is supplied

url.description: Public HTTPS screenshot, gameplay or trailer URL; validated without fetching it

monetization.description: Explain how the game earns revenue across platforms; do not guess an unknown price

pacts.description: At least one pact. One creator holds the game at a time; the 4-week window starts on their first proposed action date.

action.description: What the streamer (or YouTuber, TikToker) does: livestream, video, short, post or playtest

min_audience.description: Optional follower floor. Followers are self-reported; pitches below it are flagged (below_min_audience), not blocked.

requirement.description: Concrete requirement, e.g. "60+ min live, game title in stream title". Left out, a generic one for the action is used.

share_pct.description: Percent of the game's net revenue from every store, for 4 weeks from the earliest date in the creator's approved action plan. In percent: 10 means 10%. Above 0, at most 50. The window length is fixed.

platforms.description: Where to access/buy the actual game, each with its own price/model. At least one without a build

currency.description: Uppercase currency code, e.g. EUR or USD; required for a positive price

note.description: Price conditions, subscription period or optional purchase details

price.description: This platform's purchase price. Omit an unknown price; zero means explicitly zero, never an assumed free game

preview_review.description: Required for new html/files sent by an agent; all three flags must be true with an explicit reason. A declaration, not certification by static checks

preferable_to_direct_link.description: Must be true only if creators benefit more than by opening the original game link

reason.description: Explain that choice in 20–600 characters. It must be within the owner's authorized scope

representative.description: Must be true: this is representative of the actual game; it does not lose online/community, account, shop or ranking features

sandbox_tested.description: Must be true only after playing this exact build successfully in the allow-scripts sandbox

stage.description: Optional. Omitted means not specified on a metadata-only listing; legacy playable submissions default to prototype

store_url.description: Optional https link to where the game already sells (Steam, itch.io, your site). Revenue from every store counts in a pact window. Pass "" or null to remove it.
